title: Εἰς τὴν Πολιτείαν — Proclus, Commentary on the Republic, Essay 16 'On the Myth of Er' (RU «Комментарий к „Государству“»)
author: Proclus Diadochus
size: 17 essays, Kroll 2 vols (about 700 pp.). Essay 16 fills most of vol. II: about 250 pp., est. 70–80k words (estimate)
ru_evidence: ruwiki Прокл Диадох lists only Petrov's partial Essay 6 ('О способе создания божественных мифов', 1997) and selections (Феномен теургии, 2003, pp. 292–314; content not verified). No Russian Essay 16 found.
en_evidence: Baltzly, Finamore and Miles, Proclus: Commentary on Plato's Republic, 3 vols (CUP 2018, 2020, 2022). Lamberton, Essays 5–6 (SBL 2012). Per Open Library.
value: The fullest ancient exegesis of Plato's eschatological myth: the geography of the afterlife, the choice of lives, the spindle of Necessity, astronomy. Preserves earlier interpreters (Numenius, Porphyry). Key for Neoplatonic eschatology and theory of myth.
ai_feasibility: High. Scholastic prose, with the English version for cross-checking. The astronomical and harmonic passages need specialist review.
pilot_unit: Opening of Essay 16 (purpose of the myth, Er's 'twelve days'), about 12k words (estimate).
